title: Cook the thing you always order
summary: Pick the dish one of you always orders out, find a recipe, and make it badly together. Compare.

title: Walk the whole tram line
summary: Ride one line to the end you have never seen, then walk back a few stops. Stop at whatever looks good.

title: Museum, one room only
summary: Go in, pick one room, stay in it. Nobody has to pretend to like the rest.

title: The other neighbourhood
summary: Get off three stops early somewhere you never go and find dinner there.

title: Sunrise, once
summary: Set an alarm for something absurd, go somewhere high, bring a flask. Back in bed by nine.

title: Swim, then eat
summary: A pool or a lake, then somewhere with big portions. In that order — it only works in that order.

title: Bookshop, twenty minutes
summary: Twenty minutes each, then buy the other person the book you picked for them.

title: Cinema at four
summary: The afternoon showing, when the place is empty and the tickets are cheap.

title: Market breakfast
summary: Go early, eat standing up, buy something for later that neither of you planned.

title: A very long lunch
summary: Book somewhere for one o'clock with nothing after it. The whole point is that nothing is after it.

title: Learn one thing badly
summary: A single class in something neither of you can do. Pottery, tango, knife skills.

title: The high point
summary: Whatever the highest reachable place near you is. Go up it, look, come down.

title: Vinyl and a bar
summary: A record shop, then somewhere that will play what you bought if you ask nicely.

title: Night walk
summary: After dark, no destination, forty-five minutes. Cities are different at night.

title: Pick a country, eat it
summary: Choose a cuisine neither of you knows and find the least glamorous place that serves it.

title: Gallery then argument
summary: A small gallery, then a drink where you have to defend your favourite piece.

title: The bakery crawl
summary: Three bakeries, one thing each, decide a winner. Walk between them.

title: Botanical garden, slowly
summary: The glasshouse in winter is the best room in any city and almost always empty.

title: Cook for someone else
summary: Make too much of something and take half to a friend. Eat the other half together.

title: Ferry, bus, anything with a window
summary: Take the transport that is the point rather than the means. Sit at the front.

title: Sit in the good hotel bar
summary: One drink each in the lobby bar of a hotel you would never stay in. Nobody asks.

title: Flea market, ten francs each
summary: A spending limit and a rule: it has to be for the other person.

title: The place with one dish
summary: Find somewhere that does exactly one thing. Order it. Do not ask for changes.

title: Live music, whatever it is
summary: Cheapest gig on tonight, no research, no expectations.

title: Picnic in the wrong season
summary: Blankets, thermos, the park in November. Everyone else stayed in.

title: Table tennis, best of five
summary: Anywhere with a table. Keep score properly. It matters more than it should.

title: Rooftop, any rooftop
summary: A car park, a hotel, a bar. Height and a drink and half an hour.

title: Do the tourist thing
summary: The thing in your own city that only visitors do. There is a reason they do it.

title: The photograph, printed
summary: One picture from this year, printed properly and framed. Nobody prints anything any more.

title: A repair, not a replacement
summary: Take the broken thing they like to somebody who mends it. Boots, a watch, a chair.

title: Their childhood sweet
summary: Track down whatever they ate when they were nine. It is almost always still made.

title: A morning off
summary: Take everything on their list for one morning and do it without discussion.

title: The good version
summary: Whatever they use every day, in the version they would never buy themselves. Pen, socks, knife.

title: A class, paid for
summary: One session of the thing they keep saying they would like to try.

title: Ingredients and a night off
summary: Everything for the meal they cook best, and you do the washing up.

title: A book with a note in it
summary: Second-hand is fine. Write in the front why you picked it. That is the gift.

title: The plant they will not kill
summary: Ask the shop for the hardest one to kill and admit it is for somebody who forgets.

title: A letter, on paper
summary: A page about a specific day you remember. Post it, do not hand it over.

title: Tickets, months away
summary: Something in the calendar for a dull month. Half the gift is the waiting.

title: Their song, on vinyl
summary: Only works if you have something to play it on. Check first.

title: A map of somewhere shared
summary: The neighbourhood, printed and framed. Mark nothing — they will know.

title: The subscription they cancelled
summary: The one they gave up to be sensible. Give it back for a year.

title: Breakfast delivered
summary: Arrange it for a morning they have something difficult. Not a birthday.

title: A second one
summary: The thing they own and love and use until it wears out. Get the same again.
